verdict.rationale: Groq is an LLM inference API platform, and such a product could plausibly offer in-console, AI-generated insights about a user's usage or data, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows API building blocks (chat completions, tool use, remote MCP, structured outputs) for developers to build their own apps, plus non-AI spend limits and budget alerts. Nothing shows the product itself surfacing AI-generated insights or suggestions from the user's data.
